using namespace std;

using ll = long long int;

int main() {
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    ll i = 1;
    ll a = -1, b;

    auto better = [&](ll numerator, ll denominator) -> bool {
        if (a == -1) return true;
        return llabs(numerator * y - denominator * x) * b <
               llabs(a * y - b * x) * denominator;
    };

    while (i <= n) {
        ll j = i * x / y;
        if (i * x - j * y > (j + 1) * y - i * x)
            ++j;
        if (better(j, i)) {
            a = j;
            b = i;
        }
        ++i;
    }

    cout << a << "/" << b << endl;
    return 0;
}

using namespace std;

using ll = long long int;

struct Frac {
    ll num;
    ll den;
};

ll absoluteError(ll numerator, ll denominator, ll x, ll y) {
    return llabs(numerator * y - denominator * x);
}

int main() {
    ll x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    Frac best;
    best.num = -1;

    for (ll i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        Frac current;
        current.num = i * x / y;
        current.den = i;

        if (i * x - current.num * y > (current.num + 1) * y - i * x)
            ++current.num;

        if (best.num == -1 ||
            absoluteError(current.num, current.den, x, y) * best.den <
                absoluteError(best.num, best.den, x, y) * current.den) {
            best = current;
        }
    }

    cout << best.num << "/" << best.den << endl;
    return 0;
}
